audience: operations teams that extract fields from invoices and forms with Docsumo

useCases.title: See which documents are still processing
useCases.text: Count the documents by processing status. Then list the documents in the processing state and read the details of one.

useCases.title: Read the extracted fields of a document
useCases.text: Get the simplified extracted fields of one document. If Docsumo is still processing it, check again later. Open its review page to confirm the values.

useCases.title: Find the cases at one stage of an agent
useCases.text: List the agents, then the cases of one case type, filtered by stage. Read one case with its approvals section.

useCases.title: Upload an invoice from a public URL
useCases.text: Check the document types of the account first. Then upload a JPG, PNG, TIFF or PDF from a public URL as a new document, which uses the account's quota.
